Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel appearing for the informant.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023,
registered for the alleged offence under Sections 376, 313, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj.

4. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer on the ground that the allegations are there.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the informant submits that the allegations are there and further allegations are there of forcing to call the sister of the informant.
